header.title: OUR BUSINESSES & GLOBAL ECOSYSTEM
header.headline: Rooted in Five Hundred Years. Building What Comes Next.
header.subheadline: Driven by centuries of discipline, stewardship, and purpose, the Bishnoi ecosystem spans healthcare infrastructure, pharmaceutical access, global logistics, and social philanthropy across borders.

vision.title: From Vision to the World
vision.lead: From humble beginnings in Haryana, India, to building ventures that touch lives across five continents, our journey is rooted in a single commitment: removing barriers so people and hospitals can access what they need to thrive.
vision.paragraph: What began with a focused mission in healthcare has grown into an interconnected global ecosystem—delivering life-saving medicines, supplying hospital infrastructure, and investing in sustainable communities.

sections.title: Bishnoi Omniverse — Healthcare Infrastructure
sections.tagline: Building the physical backbone of healthcare delivery.
sections.description: Bishnoi Omniverse is a global supply powerhouse dedicated to keeping hospitals fully equipped and operational. From the smallest sterile needles to large medical gas cylinders, we ensure healthcare institutions never have to halt care due to missing supplies.

bullets.name: Bishnoi Omniverse India (LLP):
bullets.desc: Our primary global sourcing hub, leveraging India’s pharmaceutical and manufacturing strength to secure authentic, cost-effective supplies.

bullets.name: Bishnoi Omniverse Philippines (Corp):
bullets.desc: Our strategic operations and logistics center bridging Southeast Asia with international distribution lines.

bullets.name: Core Offerings:
bullets.desc: Medical-surgical consumables, infusion systems, blood transfusion products, and specialized institutional hospital supply.

sections.title: The Getmeds Ecosystem — Global Pharmaceuticals & Specialty Care
sections.tagline: Expanding access to essential, rare, and life-saving cancer medicines worldwide.
sections.description: The Getmeds network provides compassionate access and specialized pharmacy distribution, ensuring that patients and doctors can obtain vital treatments even when they are unavailable locally.

bullets.name: Getmeds Philippines:
bullets.desc: Expanding access to everyday essential medicines and healthcare services across the Philippine archipelago.

bullets.name: Getmeds Healthcare (India):
bullets.desc: A global pharmaceutical export engine enabling compassionate, Named Patient access to specialized oncology and critical care therapies.

bullets.name: Getmeds Vanuatu:
bullets.desc: The first specialty pharmacy in the Pacific region, providing local communities with reliable access to cancer treatments.

bullets.name: Getmeds Latin America:
bullets.desc: Forging cross-border distribution partnerships and expanding pharmaceutical reach across Latin American markets.

bullets.name: Getmeds Southeast Asia (SEA):
bullets.desc: Strengthening regional supply lines across emerging Southeast Asian territories.

sections.title: Social Impact, Stewardship & Sustainability
sections.tagline: Creating lasting impact across generations, communities, and the planet.
sections.description: Our businesses answer to founding principles of environmental conservation, community welfare, and ethical responsibility.

bullets.name: Naresh Bishnoi Foundation (NBF):
bullets.desc: A philanthropic initiative dedicated to creating opportunities through education, agricultural innovation, youth empowerment, and cultural preservation.

bullets.name: NKB.COM (Family Office & Initiatives):
bullets.desc: The digital platform representing the wider vision, investments, and future ventures of Naresh Kumar Bishnoi.

bullets.name: United Nations Global Compact Member:
bullets.desc: We are committed to responsible business practices, sustainable operations, and positive social impact aligned with UN global goals.

legacy.title: A Legacy Still in the Making
legacy.description: Every division runs independently with its own specialized focus, yet all move forward under one shared commitment to innovation, integrity, and human impact.
legacy.footerBrand: Bishnoi Omniverse | Part of the Bishnoi Group
